messages:
amanda: Quick heads-up — we're removing v1 default model aliases in two weeks. Need a short doc section about fallback behaviour and updated SDK snippets. cc @maria @ryan :wave

ryan: Ok — can you say what fallback we expect? Should apps silently fall back to the nearest v2-compatible variant or throw a clear error?

maria: My vote is explicit fallback by default. Apps should be able to opt into automatic fallback; otherwise return a 409-ish error with a helpful message. We need examples for both.

amanda: Prefer explicit fallback: prefer v2-matched variant (e.g., 'redwood-2-small') and fall back to hosted-compat when unavailable. But we need that spelled out, with code showing how to request fallback policy via SDK and curl. Keep examples small.

maria: I'll add TS + Python snippets. Quick question: do we expose a 'fallback' param on the client or should it be part of the model field? Example I'd prefer:

```ts
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood-2',
  fallback: 'redwood-2-small',
  input: 'Summarize the product roadmap in two bullets'
})
```

Is that OK?

kevin: Runtime will honor explicit 'fallback' param. If absent, we'll use routing policy: region -> compute-tier -> compatible-variant. We'll ship a compatibility header in responses: `x-rw-model-variant` so docs can show detection.

ryan: Nice. For the docs, we'll add a 'When models are removed' section with three bullets: what happens to requests, how to opt-in to fallback, how to detect variant served. Also include 'breaking SDK change' note re: `model` now accepts aliases and objects.

maria: Note re: SDK: v2.5 will accept `model: { name: 'redwood-2', fallback: 'redwood-2-small' }` instead of separate arg. We'll show both. I'll open a PR to `sdk-js` + docs example.

amanda: Great. Can we add a migration checklist: search docs for `model: 'redwood-1'` and update to alias or add fallback. Short CLI snippet to find occurrences?

ryan: I'll add a shell snippet:

```bash
rg "model:\\s*'redwood-1'" -n . || true
```

And a recommended replacement snippet using sed.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/452 — includes snippets and tests. @kevin can you confirm runtime header name and exact behaviour to include in docs?

kevin: Confirmed: header is `x-rw-served-variant`. If falling back, header includes `fallback=<variant>`. If request routed to hosted-compat, header `served=hosted-compat`.

doc-bot: Reminder: Docs team workflow — label PRs `docs: migration` and `/assign @ryan` to merge after tech review.

amanda: Timeline: aim to ship docs + SDK PRs in 5 business days so we can start warning emails. If anything blocks, ping here.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: docs deploy 2060006000. Will fail if missing required front-matter in migration page.

ryan: Assigned. I'll draft the migration section today and ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
